Group rides in Los Angeles, CA

7 recurring group rides around Los Angeles, CA: 6 road, 1 social, 1 cruiser. 1 roll on weeknights, 5 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Venice Electric Light Parade in Los Angeles — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? La Grange Women's Ride runs social, 16–18 mph on flats, regroups.
